=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
note the word list (Rosetta Code reads unixdict.txt; this is a fixed sample of it), newline-terminated
text dict "almost\nabbey\naccent\nbegin\nbiopsy\nchimp\nchintz\ndeist\neffort\nfirst\nghost\nglory\nfloor\nknotty\nbillowy\nbijoux\nabhors\naegilops\nthis\nthat\nzebra\nbellow\nadder\ncello\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note ordered: every letter is at least the one before it
fn ordered a view uchar * to bool
for i ulong len a
if gt i 0
if lt get a i get a sub i 1
ret false
end
end
end
ret true
end
note two passes over the list: the longest ordered length, then every ordered word of that length
fn longest to ulong
best = ulong 0
s = ulong 0
for i ulong len dict
if eq get dict i 10
n = sub i s
if and ordered part dict s n gt n best
best = n
end
s = add i 1
end
end
ret best
end
fn main to int
best = longest
s = ulong 0
for i ulong len dict
if eq get dict i 10
n = sub i s
if and ordered part dict s n eq n best
emit part dict s add n 1
end
s = add i 1
end
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
